lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A small boat leaves you on a beach with one house on it. Pink walls. A turtle asleep by the door.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: An old man in sunglasses is reading in a deck chair. He does not look up.

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: If you're selling something, I already have one.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: I heard a master lives here. I want to get stronger.

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: Ho ho. Everyone does, for about a week. Hold still.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He holds a small device to one eye. It beeps once.

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: Power level... five. Five! I've met house plants with more.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Then I've come to the right place.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The old man lowers the device and looks at you properly for the first time.

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: Hm. Most of them argue with the number. You didn't.

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: Listen. I won't teach you anything flashy. I'll give you small things to do, every day, and I'll expect them done. That is the whole school.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: That's all?

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: That's all, and almost nobody manages it. There's a spare room upstairs. Training starts tomorrow.

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: Tonight, you cook. Consider it the entrance exam.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: You are halfway through the morning chores when a shadow crosses the beach. Something yellow drops out of the sky.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A young man in an orange uniform lands in the sand, already grinning.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Master Roshi! I smelled breakfast from three islands away!

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: You smelled it because you were hoping. Sit down, you'll scare the new student.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: New student? Oh! Hey! I'm Goku. What's your power level?

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: It was five. It's about a hundred now.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: A hundred! From five! That's twenty times! You know how hard it is to get twenty times stronger?

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: It has only been a few days, Goku.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Then imagine a few more! Come on, let's train. Right now. Just a little.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: "A little" lasts until the sun is high. Every time you think it is over, he says the same two words.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: One more!

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: You said that the last four times.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Yeah, and you did every one! See? You had four more in you and you didn't even know.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He flops down on the sand beside you, not even out of breath.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: I'm gonna come by for the workouts. If that's okay. You're fun to train with.

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: He means he's coming by for the food. But you could do worse for a teacher.

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: Your body is coming along. Your mind is still a monkey in a fruit shop. I know someone who can fix that.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Another master?

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: He'd hate the word. Walk north until there's nothing left to look at. He'll be there.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: It takes most of a day. The grass gives out, then the trees. At the foot of a cliff a tall figure in a white cape sits with his arms crossed, eyes shut.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Excuse me. Master Roshi sent me.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Nothing. Not even a twitch.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: He said you could teach me to focus.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Wind. A long time passes. Your legs ache. You give up on being polite and simply sit down facing him, and wait.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The sun moves a hand's width across the sky.

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: Forty minutes.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: You sat still for forty minutes before your mind ran off. Most leave after five. They want a secret.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Is there one?

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: No. You sit. You do one thing. When your mind leaves, you bring it back. That's all of it.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He opens one eye, finally.

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: Come back tomorrow. Bring nothing. Say less.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Roshi's old scouter has been making a noise like a kettle all week. This morning it gives one last beep and dies in your hand.

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: Ah. That would be the seven hundred. It was only built for beginners.

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: There's a girl in West City who made it. Take it to her. Be polite. Be brief. She bites.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The workshop is the size of a hangar. A woman with blue hair is inside a machine up to her waist.

lines.speaker: BULMA
lines.text: If you're the delivery, leave it by the door. If you're not, you have thirty seconds.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Master Roshi's scouter broke. He said you built it.

lines.speaker: BULMA
lines.text: I built it when I was fourteen. Give it here.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: She has it in pieces before you finish handing it over.

lines.speaker: BULMA
lines.text: Nothing's wrong with it. It ran out of numbers. You maxed out a scouter. Do you know how annoying that is? Now I have to make a better one.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Sorry?

lines.speaker: BULMA
lines.text: Don't be sorry, be useful. I've got six projects open and two hands. You can clearly finish things, or that reading wouldn't exist.

lines.speaker: BULMA
lines.text: Here's the deal. I upgrade the scouter. You help me close out one of these. Start to finish, no wandering off halfway.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Which one?

lines.speaker: BULMA
lines.text: Pick. But once you pick, it's a promise. I don't keep half-built things around. They sulk.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Bulma's house has a room nobody mentions. The door is steel. A dial beside it reads 300.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: It opens while you are standing there. Heat rolls out, and a man with a towel round his neck looks you up and down.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: So you're the stray everyone keeps feeding.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: I'm training under Master Roshi. And Goku, and...

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Kakarot. Of course. He collects weaklings the way that old man collects magazines.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He takes the scouter off your face without asking, reads it, and tosses it back.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Fifteen hundred. I've sneezed harder than that.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: A while ago it was five.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Something changes in his face. Not warmth. Attention.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Five. And you're still here.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Then answer me this. Out of everything they have you doing, which one do you dread? The one you put off. The one you'd skip if nobody was counting.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: ...I know which one.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Good. That one is mine. Bring it to me every day. I won't be kind about it and I won't pretend it's easy.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: The others will make you better. I'm the only one here who'll make you hard to beat.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The steel door shuts. From behind it, the dial clicks up to 310.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: For once, all of them are at the island on the same evening. This turns out to be a mistake.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Workouts! That's the base of everything. Strong body first.

lines.speaker: BULMA
lines.text: Strong body. Sure. And who builds the thing the strong body lives in? Projects. Finished ones.

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: Neither works without focus. A strong fool with good tools is still a fool.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: You're all coddling. One hard thing a day, done without whining. The rest is decoration.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: They turn, together, to the old man in the deck chair.

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: Don't look at me. I only make sure the teeth get brushed.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The argument starts again, louder. You get up quietly and clear the table, because it's a daily, and it's on the list.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: When you come back they've gone silent. All five are looking at the chart on the wall. Your chart. Weeks of it, filled in.

lines.speaker: BULMA
lines.text: Huh. It's all on there. Every one of ours.

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: Nobody is winning this argument. The student already settled it.

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: Ho ho. Five teachers, and the timetable was the smart one all along.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: So we're all right?

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Tch. It means none of you can take the credit. Neither can I.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Vegeta looks at the chart a moment longer than the others.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: It had to come eventually. You wake late with a head full of sand. Everything on the list looks twice its size.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: You sit on the step and do nothing for a long time. One by one, they find you there.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Heavy day, huh? I get those. Do the small version. Ten instead of fifty. It still counts.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He is gone before you can argue.

lines.speaker: PICCOLO
lines.text: You're waiting to feel like it. You won't. Begin, and the feeling follows. It always has.

lines.speaker: BULMA
lines.text: You've got a system. Systems are for days like this. On good days anyone can do it.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Vegeta doesn't stop walking.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Get up or don't. But remember tomorrow which one you chose.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Roshi is last. He lowers himself onto the step beside you with a great deal of noise.

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: When you got here you couldn't have had a bad day. There was nothing to fall short of.

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: This feeling is what it costs to have standards. Expensive, I know.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: What do I do?

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: The first thing on the list. Badly, if you must. Then we'll see.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: You do the first thing. Badly. Then, because you are already standing, the second.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: By evening the list is done. Not one of them says a word about it, which is how you know they all noticed.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A hundred days without a gap. Roshi asks you to walk with him along the beach, and brings the old scouter. Bulma's first one, patched with tape.

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: Humour an old man. I want to do this the way we did on the first day.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He holds it to his eye. It hums. It whines. A thin line of smoke comes out of the side.

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: Ho ho! Well. There it goes.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: What did it say?

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: Nothing. It gave up trying. Do you remember what it said the first time?

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Five.

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: Five. And do you know what I liked about you? You didn't argue with it. You just asked where to start.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The others are waiting further along the sand. Goku is waving with both arms. Piccolo nods, once. Bulma is holding a new scouter she pretends not to have made for you. Vegeta stands apart with his back turned, which, for him, is attendance.

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: I should tell you something, now that you can take it. The number was never the point. It was only there so you'd have something to look at while the real thing happened.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: What was the real thing?

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: You turned into someone who does what they said they'd do. Every day. That doesn't show on a scouter.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He hands you the broken one to keep.

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: Now. It's nearly morning. Somebody has to deliver the milk.
